diagnose_cli.py.content:
"""Offline log diagnostic CLI. Classification lives in log_report."""

import argparse
import sys

import log_report


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Classify one log file and print its error kind."
    )
    parser.add_argument("log_path", help="Path to a UTF-8 log file")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--timed-out",
        action="store_true",
        help="Forward timed_out=True to classification",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        with open(args.log_path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            text = handle.read()
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"diagnose_cli: cannot read {args.log_path}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    kind = log_report.classify_log(text, timed_out=args.timed_out)
    print(kind)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
